sources.title: Piracy monthly report June 2025
sources.text: Six robbers armed with a gun and knife entered the engine room of a bulk carrier underway, threatened and took the oiler hostage. As the robbers retreated, the oiler raised the alarm. Crew mustered and a search was conducted. Incident reported to Singapore VTIS, and upon anchoring the Coast Guard boarded the vessel for inspection.
